resources.string: Unfinished exports — choose a destination to resume
Optional: 2026-09-30T14:30. Unknown or ambiguous timestamps are excluded when filtering by time.
Scanned: %1$d lines. Unknown/ambiguous time: %2$d. Counts cover scanned lines only.
Export scans every selected file with the last applied filters. Full export includes complete matching records and file names, without context. Metadata omits unstructured records.
Context preview only; these extra lines are not included in filtered exports.
Preview shortened; full export keeps the complete record.
A source changed or was deleted. Start a new search.
Check the selected files and start/end times. End must follow start; ambiguous times are not accepted.
Reports must be valid Cabin health JSON, at most 1 MiB each, and use the same supported schema (1 or 2).
Each page stops at 250 matching records or 2 MiB scanned. The last record is read in full, so the byte limit may be exceeded.
Export preparation was interrupted. No complete snapshot is available; discard this entry and start a new export.
